info.name: Edge Delta Access Get Metrics API

params.name: query
params.description: Edge Delta Common Query Language expression

params.name: lookback
params.description: Lookback period in golang duration format. e.g. '1h'. Either provide from/to or provide lookback/to or just lookback

params.name: order
params.description: If order_by is specified then metrics are sorted by given field. If no sort is given default sort will be asc

params.name: sort
params.description: Default is no sorting. If sort is specified then metrics are sorted by their value. Possible values: asc, desc

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of logs in the response. Default has no limit.

params.name: time_range_adjustment
params.description: Time range adjustment it can be noop, inclusive or exclusive

params.name: save
params.description: The boolean to decide whether to save the query in history

items.docs: Returns metrics with common time series response for the given query.
